draft.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
card: Electromagnetic waves form a family called the electromagnetic spectrum. From longest wavelength to shortest, the order is radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays.
All of them travel at the same speed in a vacuum. They differ in wavelength and frequency. The shorter the wavelength, the higher the frequency and the more energy each wave carries.
Each type has uses. Radio waves carry broadcasts, microwaves heat food and carry phone signals, infrared is used in remote controls and heat cameras, and X-rays show bones.
Each type has dangers. Ultraviolet can burn skin and damage cells. X-rays and gamma rays carry the most energy and can damage cells, so exposure is kept low and controlled.
draft.remember: Shorter wavelength means higher frequency and more energy. Uses and dangers differ by type.

a.q: Which list puts these waves in order from longest wavelength to shortest?
a.why: The spectrum runs from radio waves through microwaves, infrared, visible light and ultraviolet to X-rays, getting shorter each step. The list starting with X-rays is tempting but runs from shortest to longest.
a.clue: Radio waves have the longest wavelength and gamma rays the shortest.

b.q: Ravi says X-rays are more dangerous to cells than radio waves. Which reason is correct?
opts: X-rays have a shorter wavelength and carry more energy
X-rays travel faster than radio waves in a vacuum
X-rays have a longer wavelength and a lower frequency
X-rays need a medium, but radio waves do not
b.why: X-rays have a shorter wavelength and higher frequency, so each wave carries more energy and can damage cells. Speed is not the reason, because all electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
b.clue: All the waves share one speed in a vacuum, so look at what differs.

wants.brief: A horizontal bar of the electromagnetic spectrum in seven labelled sections, in order: radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays. An arrow along the top points to the right and is labelled shorter wavelength, higher frequency, more energy.
wants.why: It shows the order of the waves and how wavelength, frequency and energy change along the spectrum.
